title: Cleo Laine, Sarah Vaughan, Ella and Peggy Lee as favourites
summary: Humes first heard Cleo Laine in London but has not met her. Sarah Vaughan, Ella and Peggy Lee are her favourite singers.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Yeah. Do you know we're nearly through this tape? So let's see now. I think I still have a couple of minutes to go on this. So, did you ever hear Cleo Laine, Johnny Dankworth's wife?
I'm trying to think. The first time I heard Cleo Laine was in London.
Yeah, because they are Londoners you know. She's married to Johnny Dankworth.
Yeah, but I haven't met her.
She can come on with a whole lot of things, you know. Somebody told me that, Mercer Ellington said that they're thinking that if they send the new Broadway hit, you know, "Sophisticated Ladies", if
